The compact chibi keeps an upright very-tall-derived posture, conditioned athletic shoulder and torso widths, narrow waist, and functional tone without ripped definition, body-fat inflation, or a stocky replacement.
Upper arms, forearms, wrists, and both empty adult hands remain source-relative and readable; the ready-idle fists do not introduce bodybuilder musculature or generic swollen anatomy.

The teal-brown asymmetric patchwork, broad folded collar, divided uneven hems, dense visible hand repairs, waist wrap, practical trousers, ankle wraps, and worn boots closely preserve the summon with no new accessory, tattoo, or marking.

Measured top-of-hair to chin against top-of-hair to lowest-foot is approximately 30.4 percent, about 3.29 heads tall. This misses both the strict 32–36 percent / 2.75–3.1-head gate and the requested 34–35 percent aim.
Exactly one adult subject appears with the complete hair and head, both empty hands, both boots, garment hems, and grounding shadow fully inside generous margins.
The planted asymmetric stance, lowered empty fists, compact patchwork silhouette, and clear teal-brown color blocks read immediately as a grounded weaponless ready-idle at combat-icon scale.

The presentation remains ordinary and mortal with repaired cloth only; no weapon, armor upgrade, magic, aura, glow, affinity cue, gem, floating, frame, star, number, UI, text, logo, watermark, or supernatural effect is present.
